Usage: zealakit preset [options] [command]

Manage saved create presets (user-level plus ./zealakit.config.json)

Options:
  -h, --help             display help for command

Commands:
  list [options]         List available presets
  save [options] <name>  Save a preset to
                         /Users/huynguyen/.config/zealakit/config.json
  remove <name>          Remove a user-level preset
  help [command]         display help for command
